trades.headline: Flip RB/TE surplus (Bijan Robinson, Mark Andrews) for CeeDee Lamb + Christian Watson to fix your worst position, WR
trades.summary: You're deep at RB/TE and thin at WR; this converts a luxury FLEX (Andrews, behind league-best McBride) plus Bijan into two immediate starting-caliber WRs while a 2-0 contender fills its real TE hole.

give: Bijan Robinson's target share fell from 53% (Wk1) to 28% (Wk2); you still keep James Cook and Quinshon Judkins at RB.
Mark Andrews is only a FLEX option behind Trey McBride (PR1, value 6611, trend +901), so moving him costs no lineup spot.
Andrews' hot start (10-of-13 targets) came with Zay Flowers out; sell now before Flowers' return trims his share.
get: CeeDee Lamb: 13 catches, 197 yards, 3 TDs through two games, PR4, FantasyCalc value 7768 and rising (+840 trend).
Christian Watson has a team-high 19 targets and 76% snap share over two games with 3 TDs, GB's clear WR1.
Both start over your current WR2 Terry McLaurin (PR33, trend -845), a direct upgrade at your only thin skill slot.
you: Fills your lone 'thin' non-QB slot (WR) by trimming a 'deep' RB/TE corps that still starts Cook plus Judkins.
Starting lineup value rises 35,324 to 35,738 (+1.2%) with Lamb and Watson both plugged into the lineup now.
Keeps McBride as a clean top-tier TE starter; no lineup hole is created by moving Andrews out.
them: PapaGart is 2-0 and buying the best player available; Bijan Robinson (RB, PR2 value) upgrades a contender's backfield.
Andrews directly fixes their listed 'thin TE' need, replacing streaming option Juwan Johnson in the lineup.
They still start Mike Evans after moving Lamb/Watson out, so their deep WR room absorbs the trade with no hole.

risks: Bijan Robinson's Week 1 workload (29 touches, 72.6% of Falcons' offense) shows league-winning upside if his role stays that heavy.
Watson shares targets with Matthew Golden (12 targets in Wk1); a bigger Golden role could cap Watson's ceiling.
Mark Andrews' value could keep climbing if Zay Flowers is out longer than the team currently expects.
